basics.name: Pablo Álvaro Hidalgo
basics.label: Data & Digital Analyst | Analytics Engineering
basics.summary: Data Analyst with 2+ years of experience and a solid data engineering background, working between analytics and analytics engineering: from modelling and transforming data to delivering dashboards and business insights. Currently CRM Data Analyst in the Insights team at Ryanair, owning daily revenue and claims reporting for the CMO and working daily with Databricks (SQL, notebooks) and Power BI on customer, campaign and digital data, with hands-on experience in A/B testing, GA4 on BigQuery, automation and cloud platforms (AWS Certified Data Engineer, Snowflake). Fluent English (C1, Cambridge), degree taught in English and a full academic year exchange in the US.

work.name: Ryanair
highlights: Own the daily revenue and EU261 passenger claims reporting delivered directly to the CMO, providing a daily view of commercial performance and compensation exposure.
Analyse large-scale customer, booking and CRM campaign data in Databricks (SQL, notebooks) to drive customer engagement and commercial decisions.
Design and evaluate A/B tests on CRM campaigns and commercial levers, translating results into recommendations adopted by the business.
Develop modular, reusable SQL transformation logic and data quality checks that feed reporting, bringing an analytics engineering approach to the Insights team.
Build and automate Power BI dashboards on top of Databricks, reducing manual workload and turnaround time, and partner with marketing, commercial and pricing stakeholders to define KPIs.

work.name: Minsait (Indra Group)
highlights: Built an internal tool to automate commercial proposal generation and designed semantic data models for client systems.

work.name: Panoram Hotel Management
highlights: Primary analytical partner to the Commercial Strategy & BI Director across a multi-brand hotel portfolio.
Developed forecasting models (SARIMAX, XGBoost) for occupancy and revenue to support commercial planning.
Led data standardization and data quality initiatives, improving reporting reliability and governance.
Designed executive Power BI dashboards and automated recurring reports for senior leadership and HR.

work.name: Mediapro
highlights: Supported invoicing, cost tracking and month-end processes, using SAP for day-to-day financial operations.
Prepared Excel reports and reconciliations for the finance team.
